title: BTPD: A Multilingual Hand-curated Dataset of Bengali Transnational Political Discourse Across Online Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of a hand-curated multilingual dataset of Bengali transnational political discourse (BTPD) from Reddit, Politics Stack Exchange, and Bengali Quora, categorized using topic modeling (NMF), to facilitate future algorithmic audits of political biases and ideological polarization in NLP systems.

Addressing the lack of resources for under-resourced languages by developing a parallel multilingual corpus (Bengali and English translations) to counteract the overwhelming focus on English and other high-resource languages in computational linguistics.

Curating an ethnolinguistic dataset to address the disproportionate focus on Global North contexts in computational social science, capturing the transnational discourse of Bengali communities in the Global South (Bangladesh and India).
